snippet.title: Tina   Swordswoman of the Scarlet Prison Trailer
snippet.description:
We're excited to announce that Tina: Swordswoman of the Scarlet Prison developed by shinachiku-castella will officially release on the 2nd of August, 2019! Prepare for the release by watching the trailer and adding the game to your wishlist.

Tina: Swordswoman of the Scarlet Prison will release on August 2 on Steam https://store.steampowered.com/app/1015770/Tina_Swordswoman_of_the_Scarlet_Prison/
